tagline: Cloud-based Business Telephony Solution
description: VOYCELL is an AI-powered cloud contact center and business telephony platform that helps organizations manage customer communications from a single interface. It offers inbound and outbound calling, intelligent call routing, CRM integration, AI virtual agents, multi-dialer, live call monitoring, call recording, analytics, and omnichannel engagement. VOYCELL enables faster lead response times, improved agent productivity, and exceptional customer experiences for businesses of all sizes.

name: Ordo AI
tagline: https://ordo-ai-v1.vercel.app/
description: Ordo AI cross-references every support request — cancellations, refunds, address changes, "where's my order" — with live Shopify data, and hands your agents a structured evidence package before they act. No tab-switching. No guessing. The agent still decides.
topics: Customer Success, SaaS, Artificial Intelligence, Vercel Day

name: HeyBuddy
tagline: Your best CSM, everywhere at once.
description: HeyBuddy puts Buddy, an AI CSM as sharp as your best one, on every account in your book. He catches what's slipping or ready to grow, tells you exactly why, and drafts the next move for you to send.

name: Banalytics
tagline: Self-hosted VMS for cameras, sensors & IoT
description: Hybrid edge platform: an open-source Java agent that turns cameras, sensors, and physical systems into one automated setup, paired with a hosted portal for remote access over WebRTC. Speaks ONVIF/RTSP, Modbus, MQTT; detects with YOLO or Gemini AI. Video and sensor data stay on your hardware - the portal only handles connection and billing. Free Community plan. An alternative to Frigate, Blue Iris, and Shinobi.
topics: Hardware, Internet of Things, Home Automation

name: HomeDeck
tagline: Your HomeKit dashboard on Apple TV
description: HomeDeck turns Apple TV into a full-screen dashboard for Apple Home. Browse rooms, devices, scenes, sensors, climate information, security systems, and compatible cameras from the sofa. After inactivity, HomeDeck switches to Ambient Mode. HomeDeck is now live on the App Store for Apple TV and iPad. The TestFlight beta has ended, and the release version is available to buy and install.

name: Maestro Snap
tagline: Point at a lamp, snap your fingers, it turns on
description: Point your arm at a lamp, like you're showing it to a friend, and snap your fingers. It turns on. Maestro Snap teaches your Apple Watch where your things are. You "paint" each device once by sweeping your arm at it, and from then on the watch knows what you're aiming at. It learns from your corrections, so it gets better with use. No cameras, no hubs, no cloud. Works with Apple Home and Home Assistant. Free for one device, $8.99 one-time for the house.

name: Dtap V1.0
tagline: Hands-on automation training. No hardware required.
description: A twin to learn reality. Train on real industrial automation scenarios using DTAP — the Digital Twin Automation Process Simulator. 10-day free trial. Windows & macOS.

name: Call Box Helper
tagline: Your Gate Opens Itself
description: Call Box Helper automatically answers your call box, sends the unlock tone, and hangs up. So your gate opens without you touching your phone.

name: Teya
tagline: An AI agent for home, running on a wall‑mounted Android.
description: Teya is an open‑source AI family agent on a wall‑mounted Android phone. Multi‑user: recognizes speakers, keeps per‑person memory, “dreams” nightly to consolidate/forget. No backend: data, memory, wake word, VAD, voice ID run on‑device; cloud only for LLM, STT, TTS via Mistral (your key). Native Kotlin using Android telephony/calendar/alarms; calls are plain cellular, never joined. A private, extendable household “second brain”.
topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Home Automation

name: cctvQL
tagline: Ask your cameras anything in plain English
description: cctvQL is an open source conversational query layer for CCTV systems. Ask questions like "Were there any people at the front door last night?" and get real answers from Frigate, Hikvision, Synology, Dahua, ONVIF cameras, and more. Works with local LLMs (Ollama) or cloud (OpenAI, Claude). Integrates with Home Assistant and ioBroker. Supports face recognition, push notifications, and multi-camera setups. 100% open source, self-hosted, privacy-first.
topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Home Automation

name: Cozyla 15.6" Calendar Neo
tagline: A Smart family calendar created for simple everyday life.
description: Meet Cozyla Calendar Neo, an AI-powered digital family hub that keeps your schedules, meals, routines, and tasks organized in one shared space. With 5-minute setup, automatic iCloud/Google/Outlook calendar sync, hands-free AI voice support, chore and reward tracking, meal planning with a recipe library, and customizable photo & video screensavers, Cozyla makes everyday family organization simpler and more connected.

name: MyTesla.io - Tesla MCP
tagline: Connect your Tesla to your AI assistant.
description: Tesla MCP server that connects your car to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any AI assistant. Plain-English requests turn into real commands — composed with your calendar, weather, and the rest of your day.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Home Automation, Electric Cars

name: SayChef
tagline: Speak your recipes. AI manages your kitchen
description: SayChef is the first voice-first recipe app designed to preserve your culinary legacy. Stop losing family recipes on scraps of paper or messy notes—simply talk your recipes into existence. SayChef uses AI to instantly capture, structure, and organize your cooking history, making it perfectly searchable and easy to share. From Grandma's secret sauce to your own daily meal prep, digitize your kitchen in seconds using only your voice. SayChef: Capture the moment, savor the recipe.

name: Nexop
tagline: Smart home AI that learns your routines and automates them
description: Most hubs wait for you to write the rules. Nexop watches how your home actually runs for a week, then proposes automations you approve, edit or ignore. Everything runs on the box. Simple commands land in ~0.3s without calling the model at all. Describe an automation in plain English — "every weekday at 7pm", "when there's no motion for 5 minutes" — and it's written and live in seconds. Native Zigbee, KNX, Matter and WiFi. One-time purchase. No subscription, no cloud.

name: Lev8
tagline: Find, research, and reach the right people
description: Chat with Lev8, the fastest way to find and reach your target people and companies, powered by live web search via parallel AI agents across every corner of the internet. Enrich CSVs with waterfall lookups, monitor intent signals, and send personalized multi-channel messages, all running automatically.

name: Rerun
tagline: The easiest way to build AI agents for all your tasks
description: Most AI agents are black boxes. Rerun isn't. Build no-code agents that run 24/7, chasing invoices, qualifying leads, clearing your inbox, and watch every step in real time. They pause for approval before anything sensitive. Each workspace gets its own private server. Start with the included model, or connect your own API key or subscription

name: UCP Radar
tagline: Make your product feed visible to AI shopping agents
description: Your titles and descriptions were probably never written to Google's spec. And the fields AI agents read (material, product details, age group, highlights, FAQ) are sitting empty. Connecting UCP Radar to Merchant Center is one click. It then works through the catalog, flagging what breaks GMC rules and what hides you from AI shopping assistants, rewriting weak titles and filling the blanks. Brand names it leaves alone. Out comes a supplemental feed Google, Perplexity and ChatGPT can read.

name: dolv
tagline: Your AI operator for content, CRM, and GTM execution
description: Growth teams lose hours moving work between CRM, analytics, email, ads, and content tools. dolv brings that into one workspace. Give it a task: it reads your live funnel, does the work across your connected tools, and reports what shipped. Emails, posts, and ad changes wait for your approval before they go out. You keep the decisions. dolv handles the execution.

name: CLEO AI
tagline: Launch-ready campaigns with relevant creators in 90s
description: Generate a launch-ready LinkedIn influencer campaign in 90 seconds from your product URL. CLEO AI gives you the direction, creator shortlist, expected reach, storylines, and custom briefs you need to reach audiences in India.

name: BioScript
tagline: Self-hosted white label link-in-bio

name: EmailFunnelAI
tagline: Build complete email automation from one prompt
description: EmailFunnelAI helps teams create email sequences, newsletters, visual funnels, analytics, and Telegram-managed campaigns for SaaS, WordPress, Shopify, BigCommerce, and more from one single prompt.

name: Handler
tagline: Spy the outlier TikToks. Dupe the winners for your app.
description: Every app founder can ship fast but has no idea what to post on TikTok. So they doomscroll for hours or burn $25-$200 per UGC video hoping something sticks. Handler fixes the "what do I post" problem. It scans TikTok for the outlier videos already going viral in your niche - scored not by raw views but by Outlier score and Pull Score). Then it hands you a shoot-ready dupe kit: hook, script, and direction to remake the winning pattern for your app. Built by the team behind Flamme (acquired) 🔥
topics: Social Media, Artificial Intelligence, Marketing automation

name: Marketing & Sales: AgentMinds
tagline: Automate everything your marketing needs.
description: Deploy 80+ specialised AI agents that research, write, analyse, and automate, so you can run your business at scale without a big team. Built for founders and agencies, AgentMinds handles complex programmatic pipelines like hyper-personalized B2B cold outreach, automated analytics reporting, and daily social media scheduling. Stop doing manual workflow tasks and let your autonomous workforce take over.

name: WitFlow
tagline: Demand orchestration for the AI search era
description: WitFlow turns fragmented B2B demand generation into one connected operating system. Specialised AI workers research markets and accounts, map buying groups, create campaigns, build AEO/GEO-ready pages and prepare controlled outreach, while human experts approve external communication. Unlike point tools, WitFlow connects discovery intelligence, execution and analytics across the buyer journey—without requiring a CRM migration.

name: Kachilu
tagline: AI browser agent for controlled outbound workflows
description: Kachilu is a desktop AI browser agent for B2B outbound teams. Turn a company website or goal into a controlled workflow, then let the agent research, plan, and execute browser-based tasks with visibility, pause/resume, human handoff, and execution history. Built for marketing, sales, agencies, and recruiting teams that want more execution without losing control.

name: SEO Skill by Missing Intent
tagline: 848 real ranking signals. Zero SEO guru vibes.
description: The 2024 Google Content Warehouse API leak cross-referenced against 5,456 Google search patents. 848 classified ranking signals, 77,663 extracted patent claims, a 12-stage pipeline, and 26 decision playbooks. Installable as a Claude skill.

name: Stork Wire
tagline: Real backlinks on autopilot
description: Backlinks are still what moves Domain Rating, and what makes Google and the AI engines take a site seriously. Stork Wire builds them for you: a small news section on your own domain, real articles about your market, and members citing each other the way news does. You see every article before it publishes and can block any mention. Every page discloses it. We turn most applicants down. And your price is a formula, not a list - stronger domains pay less, down to free.

name: RankEcho
tagline: Find, fix, and prove your AI search visibility.
description: When buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google's AI for the "best" tool in your category, you're either named or you're not. Most tools just monitor — they flag a dropped score but not what to change or whether it worked. RankEcho closes the loop: Find — where AI cites competitors instead of you. Fix — a deploy-ready change for each gap. Prove — re-run the prompt and see if the citation moved. Anyone can tell you you're invisible in AI search. RankEcho proves you fixed it.

name: Robotan: AI Automation & Custom RPA

Streamline operations, reduce costs, improve accuracy, and integrate with legacy systems to accelerate digital transformation across finance, healthcare, insurance, logistics, and manufacturing.
